name: jobspresso-jobs-scraper
title: Jobspresso Scraper: Remote Jobs
description: Scrape remote jobs from Jobspresso: title, company, regions, job type, salary range, posting date and, on request, the full text and apply link. Pay-per-result.
readme:
# Jobspresso Scraper Scrape remote jobs from Jobspresso ([jobspresso.co](https://jobspresso.co/)), the hand-picked remote job board for tech, marketing, support and more. You get the title, company, the regions where the job can be done, the job type and category, the salary range when the job shows one and the posting date for every job. Turn on the job page option to add the full text, the apply link, the valid-through date and the company website. Search by keyword, location, category and job type. ## What you get - One row per job, with parsed salary numbers (from and up to, with currency and period) and a clean date. - Optional job page details: exact posting time, valid-through date, full description as HTML and plain text, apply link, employment type, countries of the applicant and the company website. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords or locations find it. - A run with no input returns 20 jobs for the keyword developer. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/jobspresso-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `jobspresso-jobs-scraper` to find up to 50 remote jobs for the keyword "developer" with the work arrangement Full Time and the location Worldwide. Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 20, "maxResultsPerQuery": 20, "searchQueries": [ "developer" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as developer, marketing, support or product manager. Each keyword is its own search. | | `locations` | Location values of the site: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Worldwide. The site matches the text literally. USA, US, UK, EU, APAC, anywhere, global and remote are mapped to these. Each place is its own search. | | `categories` | Contract, Freelance, Full Time, Internship or Part Time. Several values are allowed. | | `jobTypes` | AI & Data, Design, Engineer, Finance, HR, Marketing, Others, Product, Sales, Support or Writing. Several values are allowed. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword and location. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. | ## Sample output ```json { "id": "ai-content-reviewer-video-annotation", "post_id": 165020, "title": "AI Content Reviewer \u2013 Video Annotation", "company": "iMerit, an EXL company", "company_tagline": "Trusted by leading model innovators for mission critical domain expertise and consistently high quality.", "company_logo": "https://jobspresso.co/wp-content/uploads/job-manager-uploads/company_logo/iMerit_Logo_320x320-150x150.png", "company_website": "https://imerit.ai/", "company_page_url": "https://jobspresso.co/company/imerit%2C%20an%20exl%20company/", "location": "Worldwide", "locations": [ "Worldwide" ], "location_urls": [ "https://jobspresso.co/remote-jobs-worldwide/" ], "job_types": [ "AI & Data" ], "categories": [ "Freelance" ], "salary_text": "US$35 - US$40/hr", "salary_min": 35, "salary_max": 40, "salary_currency": "USD", "salary_period": "hour", "featured": true, "early_career": false, "remote_badge": "Fully remote company", "posted_text": "Today", "date_posted": "2026-11-03T19:43:02-05:00", "valid_through": "2027-03-03T23:59:59+00:00", "employment_types": [ "CONTRACTOR" ], "job_location_type": "TELECOMMUTE", "applicant_locations": [ "USA", "Canada", "Mexico" ], "direct_apply": false, "apply_url": "https://app.scholars.net/jobs/635", "description_html": "

100% Remote | Independent Contractor | 35 \u2013 40 USD/hour

...", "description_text": "100% Remote | Independent Contractor | 35 \u2013 40 USD/hour...", "job_url": "https://jobspresso.co/job/ai-content-reviewer-video-annotation/", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "developer", "source": "jobspresso.co", "scraped_at": "2026-11-10T12:00:00Z" } ``` This is a row with `includeDetails` on. The list of countries and the texts are shortened here. ## Fields The Mode column tells where a field comes from: `list` fields are always there, `details` fields are only filled when `includeDetails` is on (otherwise they are null, or an empty list). | Field | Type | Description | Mode | |---|---|---|---| | `id` | string | Slug of the job: the text in the job address /job//. It is the dedup key. | list | | `post_id` | integer, null | Numeric WordPress post id of the job. | list | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the job. | list | | `company` | string, null | Hiring company as shown on the job. | list | | `company_tagline` | string, null | One line about the company that the list shows under its name. Some companies have none. | list | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL. The list gives a 150 pixel thumbnail, the job page the full image. | list | | `company_website` | string, null | Website of the company as given in the job posting data. | details | | `company_page_url` | string, null | Company page on Jobspresso with all its jobs. | details | | `location` | string, null | Regions where the job can be done, joined by comma (Worldwide, United States, Europe, ...). | list | | `locations` | array | The same regions as a list. | list | | `location_urls` | array | Address of the Jobspresso page of each region, in the order of locations. | list | | `job_types` | array | Field of work tags of the job (Engineer, Sales, Support, AI & Data, Product, Design, ...). A job can have several. | list | | `categories` | array | Work arrangement of the job: Full Time, Part Time, Contract, Freelance or Internship. | list | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary as shown on the job, for example US$150k - US$200k or US$35 - US$40/hr. Only some jobs show one. | list | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound of the salary. A single amount is both bounds. With the job page the numbers come from the job posting data. | list | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound of the salary. | list | | `salary_currency` | string, null | Currency code of the salary (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, ...). Null when the symbol is not clear. | list | | `salary_period` | string, null | hour when the text says /hr (also day, week, month), otherwise year. | list | | `featured` | boolean | True for a job pinned in the featured block of the list. | list | | `early_career` | boolean | True when the site marks the job as an early career job. | list | | `remote_badge` | string, null | Badge text of the job, for example Fully remote company. | list | | `posted_text` | string, null | Date text of the list as shown (Today). Null for featured jobs, which show no date. | list | | `date_posted` | string, null | Posting date. With the job page it is the exact date and time of the job posting data (ISO 8601); otherwise a calendar date built from the date text of the list. Null for featured jobs without the job page. | list | | `valid_through` | string, null | Date and time until which the job is valid, ISO 8601. | details | | `employment_types` | array | Employment type codes of the job posting data, for example FULL_TIME or CONTRACTOR. | details | | `job_location_type` | string, null | Location type of the job posting data, TELECOMMUTE for remote jobs. | details | | `applicant_locations` | array | Countries the applicant must live in, from the job posting data. Empty when the job names none. | details | | `direct_apply` | boolean, null | Whether the job posting data says that candidates apply directly on the page. | details | | `apply_url` | string, null | Address behind the Apply button when the page shows it as a public link. Null when the button only reveals an email or opens a form. | details | | `description_html` | string, null | Full job text as HTML. | details | | `description_text` | string, null | Full job text as plain text. | details | | `job_url` | string | Address of the job on jobspresso.co. | list | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read for this row. | list | | `search_query` | string | Keyword that found the job, or all jobs for a search without keyword. | list | | `source` | string | Site the job comes from (jobspresso.co). | list | | `scraped_at` | string | Time of the scrape, ISO 8601 UTC. | list | ## Limits - The site search has no filter for the salary or the age of a job, so this Actor has none either. - The date of a job without the job page is built from the date text of the list. Only "Today" is seen on the list today; other texts such as "3 days ago" are read the same way when the site shows them. Featured jobs show no date on the list and have a null date until the job page is read. - The salary period is year unless the text says /hr, /day, /week or /month, because the site writes yearly pay as 150k without a unit. - The location filter is literal text matching on the site: Germany or USA alone find nothing unless mapped (see the input table). When a location finds no job, the run ends normally and the status names the value and lists the accepted ones. The category and job type filters are also checked against the tags of each job, so a job outside the filter is never returned. ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0015 per job result ($1.50 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [RemoteOK Scraper - Remote Jobs & Salaries | $3/1K Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/remoteok-scraper): Remote jobs and salaries from RemoteOK. - [WeWorkRemotely Scraper - Remote Jobs & Company Data | $3/1K](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/weworkremotely-scraper): Remote jobs and company data from We Work Remotely. - [Remotive Scraper - Remote Jobs & Salaries | $3/1K Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/remotive-scraper): Remote jobs and salaries from Remotive. - [Jobgether Remote Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobgether-jobs-scraper): Remote jobs from the Jobgether platform. ## FAQ **Which filters can I combine?** All of them. Locations accept several values: each value is read as its own search and a job found twice is returned once. Categories and job types accept several values in one search (a job matches when it has any of them). With several keywords, each keyword runs as its own search too. **Does includeDetails cost more?** No. The price per job is the same with or without the job page, but the run takes longer because every job page is read. **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged. **Why is the salary empty for some jobs?** Not every employer states a salary. Then `salary_text` and the numeric salary fields are `null`. **Why do some jobs have no apply link?** Some job pages only show an Apply button that reveals an email address or opens a form. Only a public link is returned; then `apply_url` is `null`. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobspresso-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
